Job description 

    
• No experience in car transport required (CE licence experience is essential)
    
• Working week: Mon–Fri (full-time; longer hours possible but not compulsory)
    
• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

Ready to hit the road? Apply today and join our team of drivers!

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

jobs.occupation: Night CE truck driver for live poultry transport
jobs.description:
Job description 
 What Does Your Night Look Like?

    
• While most people are asleep, you're on the road as a vital link in our transport operation.
    
• You collect chickens from poultry farms and transport them safely to their destination.
    
• Enjoy quiet roads and traffic-free driving from Sunday evening through to Friday morning.
    
• Using a forklift (kooiaap), you load and unload containers safely and efficiently.
    
• You complete 1 to 3 transport runs per night, visiting different locations along the way.
    
• At the end of your shift, you ensure your truck is clean and ready for the next working day.

A role that offers plenty of independence, responsibility and the freedom of night driving. Perfect for drivers who enjoy quiet roads and staying ahead of the traffic.

 Requirements 
 Do You Have the Right Drive?

    
• You are a responsible driver with a professional attitude.
    
• You are comfortable working in an environment where industry-related odours are part of the job.
    
• Experience operating a truck-mounted forklift (kooiaap) is a strong advantage.
    
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.

Job description 
 What will you do?

As a CE Driver (ADR), you will perform irregular international routes throughout Europe. You will operate in a high-stakes environment where safety, precision, and strict adherence to procedures are the top priorities.

    
• 
        
Commute with ease: Depart from home in a company car heading towards Fleurus.

    
    
• 
        
Specialized Cargo: Transport radioactive and nuclear materials.

    
    
• 
        
Versatile Fleet: Operate both open and closed trailers equipped for ADR Tank and ADR Class 7.

    
    
• 
        
International Scope: Varied, non-fixed international routes.

    
    
• 
        
Teamwork: Work in double-crew shifts.

    
    
• 
        
Client Relations: Direct interaction with customers during delivery, following rigorous security protocols.

    
    
• 
        
Regulatory Contact: Regular interaction with authorities and inspection services.

    
    
• 
        
Hands-on Work: Responsible for loading and unloading, including securing cargo (strapping).

    
    
• 
        
Administration: Accurate management of transport documents and safety checklists.

    
    
• 
        
Flexibility: A five-day work week with variable hours; weekend work may be required based on planning.

    

 Requirements 
 What are we looking for?

We are seeking an experienced driver who treats responsibility and discretion with the utmost seriousness.

    
• 
        
Qualifications: Valid License CE with proven experience in international transport.

    
    
• 
        
Certifications: ADR Tank and ADR Class 7 (or a willingness to obtain these through our training program).

    
    
• 
        
Compliance: Medically fit and all mandatory documentation in order.

    
    
• 
        
Languages: Good proficiency in Dutch, French, and English. (Knowledge of German is a strong asset).

    
    
• 
        
Soft Skills: Independent, meticulous, and resilient under pressure.

    
    
• 
        
Professionalism: A professional attitude toward clients and official authorities.

    
    
• 
        
Mindset: A team player who can also excel when working independently.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English.
    
• You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents.
    
• You have some experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.
    
• You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed.

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian

• You are flexible and customer-oriented • Living in the Geel region

• Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

As a C Driver, you will enjoy a varied role with plenty of national day routes. Every day, you will ensure our customers receive their goods on time. You will be responsible for delivering goods, both on pallets and in bulk. You will start your workday promptly at 5:00 AM in Gavere and work approximately 12 hours a day, making about 10 stops.

You are a true team player and work closely with your colleagues to provide optimal service to our customers. With your flexible attitude and early start, you are the perfect addition to our close-knit team.

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
A valid Category C driver's license and Code 95 qualification.

    
    
• 
        
Physically fit and capable of loading and unloading independently.

    
    
• 
        
Customer-oriented, flexible, and reliable.

    
    
• 
        
The ability to work independently.

    
    
• 
        
Good command of Dutch, French, or English.

jobs.occupation: Scania-liefhebber? Word chauffeur CE bij ons!
jobs.description:
Job description 

As an experienced driver, you ensure every day that goods are delivered to the right destination on time and correctly. Whether it’s curtain-side (tautliner) runs, container transport, tankers, flatbeds — you’ll encounter it all.

What does your day look like?

    
• You start between 4:00 and 5:00 a.m., leaving directly from home. (Yes, you can keep the truck at home!)
    
• Your working day averages 10 to 12 hours, after which you can put your feet up at home.
    
• You receive your schedule from the dispatcher the day before.
    
• You inspect your truck to make sure everything is safe and ready before hitting the road.

Loading & Unloading

    
• Depending on the assignment, you’ll load sea containers, tipper loads, curtain-side trailers or flatbed cargo.
    
• Make sure the load is secured safely and correctly.

Variety in Transport

    
• Every day can be different, but we take your preferences into account.
    
• If you enjoy variety, we offer different types of cargo and routes.

Arrival & Unloading

    
• Make sure all documents are completed correctly and handed in. That’s also the end of your working day.
    
• Report any issues or maintenance requirements to the technical department.

Does this sound like music — or, let’s be honest, diesel — to your ears?

Are your hands already itching at the thought of getting behind the wheel, and can you already hear those truck combinations calling your name?

Then apply today! Because real heroes don’t wait until tomorrow!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a CE driving licence and several kilometres under your belt — in other words, you have experience.
    
• You hold a valid ADR – Packaged Goods (Colli) certificate.
    
• You’re a true port expert and can find your way from quay to quay with your eyes closed.
    
• You speak Dutch, French or English fluently.
    
• You’re flexible: different truck combinations? No problem. You can handle them all.

Job description 

Are you an experienced truck driver with a passion for the open road? We're looking for a professional and motivated CE driver to join our team for international and national transport routes.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of palletized goods to our clients, including well-known companies like Hubo and Gamma. Your duties include loading and unloading the truck independently and ensuring deliveries to around five customers per day.

You’ll spend +/- 3 nights per week in your truck, giving you the freedom and independence that come with this role. Your routes will mainly take you through the Benelux, Northern France, and the Ruhr region. You are also responsible for maintaining the black box records and accurately completing CMR documents.

You will work closely with the planning department and always adhere to traffic rules and safety regulations. With your professional and safety-first mindset, you help ensure satisfied customers and a smooth operation.

What We Offer

    
• 
        
International routes with +/- 3 overnight stays per week

    
    
• 
        
Additional 2 days of national transport

    
    
• 
        
A dynamic and independent role within a stable and growing company

    
    
• 
        
Positive work environment with short communication lines

    
    
• 
        
Competitive employment conditions

    

Requirements

    
• 
        
Minimum of 3 years of experience in transport

    
    
• 
        
Able to load/unload independently and open/close the curtain (baché)

    
    
• 
        
Flexible, motivated, and open-minded attitude

    
    
• 
        
EU drivers welcome – must speak good English or German

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility regarding safety and compliance

    

Types of Goods Transported

    
• 
        
Aluminum profiles

    
    
• 
        
Automotive parts (e.g. for Honda)

    
    
• 
        
Construction materials

    
    
• 
        
Various general goods

    

Application Process Requirements 

    
• You have a CE driving license and code 95.
    
• At least 3 years of experience with a tractor-trailer.
    
• You are customer-friendly and speak good English.
    
• Basic knowledge of French, German, or Dutch is a plus!

Job description 

Join our family team as you transport specialized cargo like heated liquids across the Benelux, Germany, and France. You will navigate your routes with modern, well-equipped trucks while enjoying a steady schedule from Monday to Friday. During your first six months, you receive thorough supervision to help you settle into the role comfortably. This position offers a perfect blend of meaningful independence and high-quality equipment, ensuring you feel confident and supported every time you head out on the road.

You will work alongside a dedicated group of colleagues in an environment where safety is our main priority. We value your professionalism, offer fair compensation for all hours worked, and look forward to providing a permanent contract after your probationary period. With your ADR certification and a strong sense of responsibility, you will play a vital role in our daily operations. We cannot wait to welcome you and see you behind the wheel of one of our new trucks soon.

 Requirements 

    
• Valid CE driver's license and ADR tank certificate.
    
• Proven experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Strong focus on accuracy and safety-consciousness.
    
• Availability to work two weeks per month.
    
• Good language skills in Dutch and/or English.

Job description 

As part of our growing family, you will operate modern, well-equipped trucks to conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France. You will be responsible for handling specialized cargo, such as heated liquids, while enjoying a schedule that runs from Monday to Friday with occasional national day trips. We value your safety and professionalism, offering you thorough training and supervision during your first six months to ensure you feel completely at home within our supportive team.

You will enjoy a role that balances independence on the road with the warmth of a close-knit company culture. We offer a permanent contract following a successful probationary period and provide fair compensation for all your hours. If you hold an ADR certification and bring your reliable, responsible mindset to our team, you will be well-supported by your dedicated colleagues every step of the way. We look forward to welcoming you into our family and getting you behind the wheel soon.

 Requirements 

    
• Possess a valid CE driver's license and ADR tank certificate.
    
• Proven experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Strong focus on accuracy and safety-conscious work habits.
    
• Availability to work two weeks per month.
    
• Good command of Dutch, French and/or English.

Job description 

Love driving? We’re looking for a CE truck driver for day trips transporting pallets—full or empty, you’ll handle them all!

    
• 
        
Early start: 4–6 a.m.

    
    
• 
        
Average driving: 10–13 hours/day

    
    
• 
        
2–5 stops daily – build great client relationships

    
    
• 
        
No loading/unloading – technical support provided

    
    
• 
        
Work area: Belgium, S. Netherlands, W. Germany & N. France

    
    
• 
        
Shadow an experienced driver on your first day for a smooth start

    

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we provide the guidance you need.

Apply now and join our team!

 Requirements 

Your profile To be successful in this role, you meet the following requirements:

    
• Papers: You possess a valid CE driving license and up-to-date Code 95.
    
• Language skills: You can express yourself fluently in Dutch, French, and English. This is essential for communication during international stops.
    
• Reliability: You are punctual, keep appointments, and handle equipment with care.
    
• Technical skills: Do you already have experience with the Transics black box? Then you have an advantage!
    
• Attitude: You are an early bird who can work independently.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

 

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

jobs.occupation: Fit-Out Project Manager | Workplace Design & Build M/V/X
jobs.description:
Join our team!
Space Refinery is looking for an experienced Fit-Out Project Manager to join our international team of workspace designers and builders.

We design and build people-centered workplaces for companies across Belgium. Our spaces support innovation, collaboration, and the real needs of the people who use them.

We're looking for someone who brings the same care, ambition, and attention to detail to the execution of our projects.

If you love turning great designs into beautifully executed spaces, enjoy bringing structure to complexity, and get satisfaction from delivering projects that make people happy, we'd love to meet you!
What this role is about
You'll take ownership of office fit-out projects from preliminary budgeting and construction preparation through to successful handover, ensuring they're delivered safely, on time, on budget, and to the quality our clients expect.

You'll work closely with our in-house design-and-build teams, contractors, suppliers, and clients, with the autonomy to lead your projects while benefiting from the support of a collaborative team.
What you'll be in charge of
• Own your projects: Lead office fit-out projects from preparation and procurement through site execution and handover.
• Coordinate people and priorities: Bring contractors, suppliers, and internal teammates together around clear responsibilities, deadlines, and deliverables.
• Control planning and budgets: Proactively manage schedules, costs, change requests, and financial risks to keep projects commercially healthy.
• Build client confidence by Communicating clearly, managing expectations, and creating a smooth, professional project experience.
• Stay ahead of challenges: Identify risks early, explore solutions, and take action before issues escalate.
• Deliver quality: Maintain high standards of workmanship, site safety, and attention to detail.
• Help us get better: Contribute ideas and improvements to how we plan, coordinate, and deliver our projects. What we're looking for
We're looking for a confident, hands-on project manager who combines technical understanding with strong organization, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset.

You don't need to know everything about our way of working from day one, but you should bring the experience and independence to take real ownership of project delivery.

• Proven experience managing construction, renovation, or interior fit-out projects, ideally in commercial or workplace environments.
• Strong technical understanding of construction processes, interior works, and site coordination.
• Confident in managing project budgets, planning, and contractors and suppliers.
• A proactive, solution-oriented approach: you anticipate challenges rather than simply react to them.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build client trust and collaborate across teams.
• A structured and organized way of working, even when things get complex or move fast.
• Fluency in English, with working proficiency in Dutch and/or French.
• 
A valid B driving license and authorization to work in Belgium.

Most importantly, you take pride in your work, care about the people you work with, and genuinely enjoy seeing great projects come to life.

Please note: Candidates must be based in Belgium and legally authorized to work here.

Space Refinery is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.
 Why join Space Refinery?
• We're an international team of creatives and construction experts based in Brussels, on a mission to create a better world, one workspace at a time.
• We're growing our build capabilities and taking on exciting, increasingly ambitious projects. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, bring your ideas to the table, and help shape how we deliver exceptional workplaces.
• What you can look forward to:
• 🌍 An international, talented team of people who care about good design, great execution, and each other.
• 💪 Real ownership and autonomy, with the trust to lead your projects and the support to succeed.
• 🚀 Exciting, varied projects where you can see the tangible impact of your work.
• 🤝 Close design & build collaboration, bringing creative ideas and technical execution together under one roof.
• 🤓 Continuous learning and growth, through knowledge sharing, coaching, and opportunities to develop.
• 🙌 A flexible, collaborative work culture built on trust, accountability, and positive team spirit.
